preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100000 and 0 <= k <= n for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 10^5, and k is between 0 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, k in test_cases) <= 2000000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^6.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1' and (n - k == 1)) or (line != '-1' and (n - k != 1)) for (n, k), line in zip(test_cases, output_lines))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if n - k equals 1, the output is -1; otherwise, the output is not -1.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1') or (len(parts) == n and set(map(int, parts)) == set(range(1, n + 1)) and sum(1 for i, val in enumerate(map(int, parts), start=1) if val == i) == k) for (n, k), line in zip(test_cases, output_lines))
postconditions.description: For each test case where the output is not -1, the output line contains n space-separated integers forming a permutation of 1 to n, and exactly k indices i satisfy A[i] == i (using 1-based indexing for the condition).
